title: Attic Red-Figured Column Krater Attributed to the Boreas Painter

said.q: In fact, most of the statues and buildings we now associate with ancient Athens were created during this dynamic period: the temples on the Acropolis, the Theater of Dionysus, and the Athenian Agora were all erected in this era. The political developments of this period were equally remarkable: not only did Athens become the first fully developed democracy, but it was also an important imperial power guided by the skillful politician and orator Pericles.

events.q: This column krater is attributed to the artist known as the Boreas Painter
